projects.name: Sayroura
projects.tagline: From the reservation to the handover of keys — the operating system for Algerian property developers.
projects.description: A multi-tenant SaaS that runs a property developer end to end: inventory and price lists, a sales CRM, reservations and off-plan sales (VSP) with payment schedules, receipts and reminders, treasury and accounting exports, construction follow-up and deliveries, then the residence itself — co-ownership charges, general assemblies, rentals — plus a portal where buyers follow their payments and their building. Bilingual French / Arabic (RTL), with a live 3D « Maquette » of every project and an AI assistant for the operators.

fr.tagline: De la réservation à la remise des clés — le système d'exploitation des promoteurs immobiliers algériens.
fr.description: Un SaaS multi-tenant qui fait tourner un promoteur de bout en bout : stock et grilles de prix, CRM, réservations et ventes sur plans (VSP) avec échéanciers, reçus et relances, trésorerie et exports comptables, suivi de chantier et livraisons, puis la résidence elle-même — charges de copropriété, assemblées générales, locations — et un espace client où l'acquéreur suit ses paiements et son immeuble. Bilingue français / arabe, avec une « Maquette » 3D vivante de chaque programme et un assistant IA pour les opérateurs.

ar.tagline: من الحجز إلى تسليم المفاتيح — نظام التشغيل للمرقّين العقاريين في الجزائر.
ar.description: منصّة SaaS متعددة المستأجرين تُدير المرقّي العقاري من البداية إلى النهاية: المخزون وقوائم الأسعار، وإدارة العملاء، والحجوزات والبيع على التصاميم مع جداول الدفع والإيصالات والتذكيرات، والخزينة والتصدير المحاسبي، ومتابعة الورشة والتسليم، ثم إدارة الإقامة نفسها — أعباء الملكية المشتركة والجمعيات العامة والإيجارات — مع فضاء للمشتري يتابع فيه دفعاته وبنايته. ثنائية اللغة فرنسية / عربية، مع « ماكيت » ثلاثية الأبعاد حيّة لكل مشروع ومساعد بالذكاء الاصطناعي للمشغّلين.

caseStudy.challenge: Algerian property developers sell apartments off-plan years before the keys are handed over, and the whole cycle — stock, prospects, reservations, VSP contracts under Loi 11-04, payment calls tied to construction milestones, receipts, reminders, then co-ownership once the building is delivered — usually lives in Excel sheets, paper receipt books and WhatsApp. Buyers can't see what they owe or how the building is progressing, and managers have no single picture of sales, cash and the site. Everything has to work in French and Arabic, in dinars, and hold up legally.
caseStudy.approach: One Next.js 16 app on PostgreSQL, built so a company's data can never leak to another: every tenant table gets forced row-level security from a migration hook, with composite foreign keys and a test that fails CI if any table is missing it. Money is integer centimes, documents are numbered without gaps, and every change is audited. Background work (bilingual PDFs rendered by headless Chromium, e-mails, reminders, nightly digests) runs in a pg-boss worker, enqueued in the same transaction as the business write. On top sit the modules — inventory, CRM, sales and schedules, treasury and accounting exports, construction and deliveries, rentals, residence management, a buyer portal with card payments through SATIM and e-signature — plus a three.js « Maquette » that draws every project in 3D through lenses (sales, market, collections, works), and an operator console with billing and an AI agent that triages the mailbox and drafts replies a human approves.
caseStudy.result: In five weeks: a pilot-ready product covering the developer's whole cycle, from the first lead to the general assembly of the delivered residence. A seeded demo group — projects on sale, delivered residences, rentals, a building run as syndic for its co-owners — exercises every module, guarded by 155 unit/integration test files and 27 Playwright end-to-end suites. Pilots are open to developers, with launch prices set.

projects.name: Sayroura POS
projects.tagline: Point of sale and multi-shop management for every kind of shop in Algeria.
projects.description: A Windows point of sale that adapts to the shop it runs in. In the first-run setup each shop picks its niche — fashion, hardware, grocery, cosmetics, phones and electronics, or general — and Sayroura sets up its variants (sizes × colours, formats × flavours, capacities…), units, starter families and features such as expiry lots or IMEI tracking. The till, stock per shop, cash sessions and Z reports, returns and exchanges, loyalty, compliant invoices, card terminals, LAN counters, shop-to-shop sync and a website connector come with every niche, in French and Arabic.

fr.tagline: Caisse et gestion multi-boutiques pour tous les commerces en Algérie.
fr.description: Une caisse Windows qui s'adapte au commerce où elle tourne. À la première installation, chaque boutique choisit son activité — mode, quincaillerie, supérette, cosmétique, téléphonie ou commerce général — et Sayroura prépare ses variantes (tailles × couleurs, formats × saveurs, capacités…), ses unités, ses familles et ses fonctions comme les lots à péremption ou le suivi IMEI. Caisse, stock par boutique, sessions et rapport Z, retours et échanges, fidélité, factures conformes, TPE, postes en réseau, synchronisation entre boutiques et connecteur de site web, en français et en arabe.

ar.tagline: نقطة بيع وتسيير متعدد المحلات لكل أنواع التجارة في الجزائر.
ar.description: نقطة بيع لنظام Windows تتكيّف مع المحل الذي تعمل فيه. عند التثبيت يختار كل محل نشاطه — ملابس، أدوات وموادّ، مواد غذائية، تجميل، هواتف وإلكترونيات أو تجارة عامة — فيُهيّئ سيرورة متغيّراته (مقاسات × ألوان، أحجام × نكهات، سعات…) ووحداته وعائلاته ووظائفه مثل تواريخ الصلاحية أو تتبّع IMEI. الصندوق، والمخزون لكل محل، وجلسات الصندوق وتقرير Z، والإرجاع والاستبدال، والوفاء، والفواتير المطابقة، وأجهزة الدفع، والمراكز في الشبكة، والمزامنة بين المحلات، وربط الموقع — بالفرنسية والعربية.

caseStudy.challenge: Most Algerian shops still run on a receipt book, Excel or a generic till that knows nothing about their trade: a clothing shop sells a size and a colour, not just an article; a hardware store sells by the metre; a grocery tracks expiry dates; a phone shop tracks every IMEI. On top of that, owners with several shops need stock and cash per shop, and every invoice has to follow Algerian rules — VAT per rate, stamp duty on cash, gapless numbering with NIF / NIS / RC — in French and Arabic.
caseStudy.approach: One Electron app on SQLite, built for a shop's reality: a server PC per shop, thin counters on the local network, and shop-to-shop sync between servers. A first-run setup asks for the company, its fiscal identity and its shops, and each shop's niche configures the variant axes, units, starter families and features — so one codebase serves a boutique and a hardware store without forking. Stock is held per shop and per variant behind an atomic oversell guard; cash sessions close with a Z report; returns, exchanges and credit notes keep the books straight; factures are numbered without gaps and frozen at issue, and the monthly G50 is computed from the sales. Role-based rights with discount limits, loyalty, card terminals, label printing and a documented website connector round it out, under a liquid-glass interface in light and dark, French and Arabic.
caseStudy.result: A Windows installer (v1.0) that a new shop configures in a few minutes. The codebase grew from GestionPOS, a wholesale distributor's tool, through a single clothing retailer, into a product for any kind of shop — 65 schema migrations later, with its business rules covered by 61 Vitest suites against real SQLite.

projects.name: E2Echat
projects.description: A widget-first chat platform with multi-tenant isolation, role-based access, audit logging, webhooks and a BullMQ job queue — NestJS, Prisma and Redis on the back, a Vite/React SPA on the front.
